title: Louis Armstrong if he had been white
summary: JCH thinks Armstrong has more money than Goodman; the interviewer disagrees.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: ... question at this junction. J. C., what do you think Louis Armstrong would have been like if he had been white?
He'd have been a white millionaire; he's got enough money. Yeah but when you think of, have you any notion how much money Benny Goodman and people like that have?
Benny Goodman ain't never had much money as Louis Armstrong.
I think you're wrong about that.

And you know why I say I think you're wrong about it. Basically what has happened is that Benny Goodman was fortunate to have people around him who said, Oh, you have $5, let me show you how to make that $5 grow into $500. And Louis Armstrong might have had $500 but nobody was around to say ...
He has $500 in the bank and what's his name had $500 in investments. John Hammond, the man you praised very highly is extremely wealthy man. Did he play anything? John Hammond?
